zh-CN.title: 《转法轮经》（Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta）
zh-CN.subtitle: 鹿野苑初转法轮传统中的早期佛教经文
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《转法轮经》把佛陀在鹿野苑向五比丘说法的传统保存为一组可追溯的经文传承。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把‘佛陀说法’作为经文传述和后世编纂层来展示，不把文本当作现代意义上的现场录音或逐字速记。
zh-CN.researchNote: SN 56.11 的文本、语言、结集和传抄历史需要与鹿野苑考古遗址及后世汉译传统分别连接。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 早期佛教传述；文本形成与结集年代不等同于佛陀生平

en.title: Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta
en.subtitle: An early Buddhist discourse in the tradition of the first turning at Sarnath
en.shortSummary: The Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta preserves a transmitted discourse tradition in which the Buddha teaches the five mendicants at Sarnath.
curatorialDescription: The museum presents ‘the Buddha taught’ as a transmitted and compiled textual layer, not as a modern recording or verbatim stenographic transcript.
en.researchNote: The text, its language, recitation and compilation history must be connected separately to Sarnath's archaeology and later Chinese translation traditions.
en.timeLabel: Early Buddhist transmission; textual formation is not the same as the Buddha's lifetime

displayDate.zh-CN: 早期佛教传述；文本形成与结集年代仍需分层
displayDate.en: Early Buddhist transmission; textual formation and compilation remain layered questions
